item.description:
I am an economist (PhD, MIT) and Assistant Professor of Economics at Stockholm University. I am also a Senior Fellow at Etla and affiliated with RFBerlin, IZA@LISER, and CESifo.

My research focuses on technology, work, and psychology, using large-scale data. This research has been featured in The Economist, Wired, Bloomberg, and The Washington Post. My PhD thesis received the Upjohn Institute Award, and HS, Finland’s leading newspaper, listed me in their 35 under 35.
